treatment.name: CSV identifier binding restoration
treatment.control: Frozen pre-fix CSV lookup and its reproducibly reconstructed context.
treatment.treatment: SQLite ASCII case-insensitive lookup; preserve actual schema identifiers, reject ambiguous metadata bindings.
treatment.known_downstream_effects: Restored metadata changes ranked snapshot fields for the five affected D cases; table and relationship scopes are unchanged in this frozen D50. Do not claim the snapshot hash or full prompt is unchanged.

population.selection: Select every D case whose pre/post rendered schema input differs, before observing any new candidate. This is an input-defined diagnostic slice, not a result-selected gain sample.
population.unchanged_disposition: Verified input identity offline; do not represent these as newly generated evaluation outcomes.
population.canary_reason: One known missing-value target plus the lowest-ID pre-frozen affected metric-pass control; membership chosen before generation.

design.primary_metric: Official EA gain/loss on the five affected cases; diagnostic only
secondary_metrics: Contract v2 gain/loss with full denominator

design.condition_order: Alternate control-first then treatment-first across the frozen case order. Both arms use their existing output contracts within each condition.
design.control_backend: Pinned pre-fix context/evaluation source in an isolated process, not a legacy branch added to production.
design.treatment_backend: Pinned corrected context/evaluation source in a separate isolated process.
design.orchestration: Use existing Pi Run persistence; record every condition run_id and candidate in the experiment manifest. Never disable context/revision validation, overwrite old runs, or introduce a second business task store.

requested_model.reason: User explicitly chose Luna; both control and treatment use Luna. No comparison against historical Sol is used to infer treatment effect.
requested_model.capability_verified_sampling: Explicit temperature rejected by provider; omit it and use provider-default sampling in both conditions.

budget_proposal.concurrency: One case/condition at a time; retain the same within-condition two-arm policy in both conditions.
budget_proposal.actual_requests_include: Every generation attempt, error, invalid tool output and any retry; quota/auth checks are not answer generations and must be reported separately.
budget_proposal.token_cost_guard_proposed: Total treatment tokens no more than 1.20 times control on this diagnostic slice; crossing is a stop/review signal, not a statistical latency claim.
budget_proposal.latency_guard_proposed: Treatment P95 no more than 1.25 times control; n=5 is descriptive only.
budget_proposal.currency_cost_reason: No observed provider settlement price; do not fabricate money estimates.
budget_proposal.output_token_limit_status: Installed Codex adapter does not serialize maxTokens into its request body. 8192 is an unimplemented proposal, not a verified token or financial cap.

activation_blockers.name: user_budget_and_scope
activation_blockers.required: Explicitly approve the 20-request diagnostic slice, including allowance to develop on D while independent H review remains pending; no generalization claim is allowed.

activation_blockers.name: actual_request_parameter_binding
activation_blockers.evidence: Current Pi Run stores temperature=0 and max_output_tokens=8192, but the createAgentSession/session.prompt path does not explicitly pass these fields; this does not prove which provider defaults or extension overrides applied historically. Executed installed Codex streamSimple with synthetic credentials and stopped in onPayload before network: explicit temperature=0 is serialized, explicit maxTokens=8192 is not. This does not exercise live provider acceptance or extension overrides.
activation_blockers.required: Before generation, bind or honestly record supported sampling/output settings, capture sanitized effective payload evidence, pin model and source/input revisions. Reject unsupported requirements; do not relabel historical values as verified.
activation_blockers.resolution: After two provider 400 rejections of explicit temperature, use default sampling symmetrically. Hook asserts temperature absent and saves effective payload. No output-token cap claimed.

activation_blockers.name: hard_request_budget
activation_blockers.evidence: Executed SettingsManager.inMemory with the current benchmark settings: retry.enabled=true, maxRetries=3; provider maxRetries unset.
activation_blockers.required: Disable session/provider retries and enforce one billed-generation attempt per arm plus the total authorized cap. Prove against an isolated no-provider-call smoke before activating.
activation_blockers.resolution: Isolated wrapper enforces request cap and disables both retry layers before real SDK calls.

activation_blockers.name: empty_or_incomplete_candidates
activation_blockers.required: Infrastructure failure, missing candidate, token truncation or revision/context mismatch stops the experiment; do not score an incomplete run as an accuracy result.
activation_blockers.resolution: Isolated wrapper enforces request cap and disables both retry layers before real SDK calls.

decision_rules.canary: Only validate model availability, schema-bound output, request limits and complete capture; no accuracy-based retry or candidate selection.
decision_rules.keep_for_next_stage: Target binding error is demonstrably corrected in fresh outputs, both official/contract changes and regressions are reported, affected controls have no unexplained regression, safety/cost limits hold.
decision_rules.stop_or_reassess: No verified target improvement, new unexplained wrong controls, request/cost overflow, unsupported parameter enforcement or incomplete capture.
decision_rules.inference_limit: Five affected cases cannot establish overall accuracy improvement or statistical superiority. A single target repair cannot be extrapolated to 500 cases.

heldout.sample_size_selection: Do not select final H membership before source/overlap/label review and a chosen precision/power target plus budget. A public same-database slice is not unseen-database generalization.

power_sensitivity.method: Sum over K~Binomial(n,q), G|K~Binomial(K,(q+delta)/(2q)); reject in positive direction when two-sided exact McNemar p<=0.05.
assumptions: Independent case pairs; fixed discordance probability q; no clustering correction.
This is a design sensitivity calculation, not observed benchmark power or model performance.
No outcome-dependent sample expansion. Same-database or semantic clusters can reduce effective information.

heldout.warning: At q=0.1, even n=400 has only about 41.85% power for +3pp; do not call a small holdout adequately powered or reinterpret non-significance as no effect.

verification.normalizer_limit: AST and near-duplicate decisions retain source-agent evidence; 159 exposure SQL parse/qualification failures and independent semantic review remain unresolved.
